name: What is the typical process for diagnosing a septic line problem?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for diagnosing a septic line problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Diagnosing a septic line problem usually begins with a visual inspection of your property and system components. Plumbers may use advanced techniques like sewer camera inspections, which involve feeding a waterproof camera into the septic line to identify blockages, cracks, root intrusion, or collapses without extensive excavation. This non-invasive method allows for precise identification of the issue's location and severity, enabling CG Plumbing Solutions to recommend the most effective repair solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Diagnosis often starts with a visual inspection, followed by a sewer camera inspection to precisely locate and identify issues like blockages or cracks.
